svg.title: FlareOn13 document polyglot and raw-sector offset mapping
svg.desc: Document layout and offset conversion: DOS stub begins 0; PDF header at hex 84; PDF object stream at B2; 2352-byte raw sectors begin at zero, each with 16-byte front and 2048-byte payload starting at 16; UDF file click_me begins sector 278 and original offset 9FA30; six-MD5 table at original F9070 in sector 433 maps to click_me fat offset 4DE30 and second slice offset 35E30; ZIP at 1C4E3F and fixed VHD footer at 1C4F8F.

g.text: One file, three sets of offsets
All hex offsets are measured in the unmodified flareon13.doc unless the row says UDF, fat file, or Mach-O slice.
PDF stream starts 0xB2; raw-sector grid started at 0x00
click_me first byte at 0x9FA30 • MD5 table at 0xF9070
Repeat for each of 781 raw CD-ROM sectors (2352 bytes each)
16 - 2063: take all 2048 user-data bytes → UDF logical sector
Map the encoded MD5 records to code, not by simple subtraction
Source: flareon13.doc offsets 0x84, 0xB2, 0xF9070, 0xF9130, 0x1C4E39/3F, 0x1C4F8F; UDF 278×2048 extent; Mach-O fat slice1 offset 0x18000.
